summary: Line-by-line transcription of the two lists in nine Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports (2020 H1 to 2024 H1): the National Development Fund contribution list (one row per application, by nationality and date) and the CIU operating-account disbursement list (one row per payment). Scans were read by OCR cell by cell with several renderings compared; 2022 H1 has a text layer. The NDF lines add up to the printed totals in seven reports; 2022 H2 and 2024 H1 fall short, consistent with lines missing from the stored lists. Disbursement lists print no totals; 17 payments whose amount could not be read reliably are listed in the ledger to_do instead of being recorded.

observations.location: PDF p. 8, Appendix III (NDF contribution list), line 1 of the page
observations.notes: One application in the NDF contribution list (Appendix III, 'Citizenship by Investment National Development Fund Contribution'): submitted 2-Jan-20; 3 person(s) in the application; type NDF. Nationality printed as 'Nigeria'. Currency not printed (the list prints a bare '$' or no sign). Recorded as US dollars, guessed (METHODOLOGY.md decision 4), as for this list's printed total: the amounts are the National Development Fund contribution levels, which the CBI regulations set in US$ (US$100,000 for up to four persons, US$125,000 for larger families at the time), while EC$ would make them about 2.7 times too large. Read from the scanned page by OCR (tesseract, cell by cell, several renderings compared).

new_indicators.name: Payment out of a CBI unit's operating account
new_indicators.definition: One payment (cheque, wire or transfer) out of a citizenship-by-investment unit's operating account, as listed line by line by the programme (one row per payment). Period is the date of the payment (day precision); breakdown item= carries the cheque or transfer reference. The payee's kind (government body, company, international organisation, charity, or 'individual' without the name) and the printed purpose are in notes. Money.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extraction passes extract-cbi-atg-lists-a/-b for the Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports (Appendix V, 'Operating Account Disbursements'). Currency not printed in the 2020-2024 lists; rows are XCD with unit_basis guessed (the 2015 H2 edition heads the same list 'Amount EC$').
